kv.memory.toip-spec-usage-gotchas: ToIP spec-usage facts verified 2026-10-21 by a conformance audit against local spec copies in ~/PROJECT/ToIP/spec/ (toip-*.md; grep them, don't read whole). Apply when designing the JMAP space/room/admin/membership oracle: (1) TRQP /authorization answers 'does authority_id authorize entity_id to take action on resource'; responses are unsigned JSON over HTTPS only (TSP binding just 'may be considered'), so a TRQP answer is NOT verifiable evidence and can't be an ACDC edge. (2) Current status of a role/membership credential = its ACDC TEL state (issued/revoked); there is no 'superseded' state, and revoking a node can invalidate edges pointing to it, so supersede with a new credential plus an NI2I edge, don't revoke. (3) IPEX routes: apply, spurn, offer, agree, grant, admit; gating disclosure on an external check is discloser-local policy. (4) An ACDC edge to a node whose issuee you are not needs o: NI2I (default is I2I). (5) Trust Tasks extCritical only names ext namespaces inside payload, only where a task spec opts in; it can't pin core payload fields. (6) Private Trust Task type URIs: <your-domain>/spec/<slug>/<MAJOR.MINOR>, never trusttasks.org; responses use #response; task errors namespaced like myspec:unknownX; request docs carry proof unless a transport binding permits omitting it. Related pattern: policy-as-pinned-credential oracle in docs/policy-package-oracle-spec.md (this repo, github.com/MarkAtwood/toip-explore).
